ranged_attack.name: Blood Bolt
ranged_attack.windup: turns his shoulders side-on and raises his right hand at {target}, fingers spread as a glowing crimson orb condenses in his palm
ranged_attack.release: clenches his hand and the orb tears free as a blazing crimson bolt with a dark red core
ranged_attack.travel: the bolt streaks across the courtyard as a bright crimson line trailing glowing red mist
ranged_attack.impact: it bursts against {target} in a sharp crimson flash and a spray of glowing red droplets of light
ranged_attack.decay: the crimson glow vanishes in a split second, leaving {target} in clear view
ranged_attack.again: extends his hand again and casts another blazing crimson bolt that flashes against {target} and vanishes at once
ranged_attack.text: raises his hand at {target}, a crimson orb condensing in his palm, and casts a blazing blood bolt that bursts in a sharp crimson flash on it and vanishes at once

melee_attack.name: Blood Claw
melee_attack.windup: steps in and raises his clawed right hand high to the side, crimson light gathering along his fingertips
melee_attack.impact: his claws rake down across {target}, leaving three glowing crimson streaks of light in the air
melee_attack.decay: the crimson streaks fade at once
melee_attack.recover: lowers his hand, his coat settling around him
melee_attack.again: rakes {target} again with glowing crimson claws, three streaks of light that fade at once
melee_attack.text: raises his clawed hand high and rakes it down across {target}, leaving three glowing crimson streaks of light that fade at once

dash.name: Mist Step
dash.text: dissolves into glowing crimson mist that rushes forward and re-forms into his body
